dishes.make_ahead: Soak and dry up to 2 hours ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water.
Drain and dry very well.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 140C for the first cook until pale and soft, then lift out and rest.
Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp.
Salt straight away and serve with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.

dishes.make_ahead: Best baked just before serving; have the beans, cheddar and toppings ready in the fridge up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Spread the chips over a tray.
Dot with the refried beans and scatter over the cheddar and jalapenos.
Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Top with sour cream and salsa and serve at once.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; season, griddle and build just before serving

steps.text: Shape the mince into four thick patties. Prep the lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.
Season just before cooking and griddle on a hot surface to medium.
Lay cheddar on top and cover with a lid until melted.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with all the toppings.

veg.n: Big Jeff's mushroom and haloumi burger
veg.make_ahead: Trim the mushrooms and prep the toppings up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; griddle and build just before serving

steps.text: Trim the mushroom stems. Prep the lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, season and griddle on a hot surface, pressing down, until tender.
Griddle the haloumi until golden, sit a slice on each mushroom, lay cheddar on top and cover with a lid until melted.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with all the toppings.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve warm

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Toss the cherries with the sugar, lemon juice and cornflour.
Line a pie dish with two pastry sheets and fill with the cherries.
Cut the other two sheets into strips and weave a lattice over the top.
Bake until deep golden and the filling bubbles. Cool a little before slicing.

dishes.n: Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre
dishes.make_ahead: Cut the limes up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; build the drinks over ice just before serving

steps.text: Cut the limes into quarters.
Fill four highball glasses with ice and squeeze two lime quarters into each, dropping the shells in.
Add the rum and a dash of bitters to each glass, top with cold cola and stir once.

af.n: Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre (alcohol-free)
af.make_ahead: Cut the limes up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; build the drinks over ice just before serving

steps.text: Cut the limes into quarters.
Fill four highball glasses with ice and squeeze two lime quarters into each, dropping the shells in.
Add a drop of vanilla to each glass, top with cold cola and stir once.
